title: John H. and Elisabeth A. Hobbs Research Professor of Cognition and Education
bio: Catherine Snow is an expert on language and literacy development in children, focusing on how oral language skills are acquired and how they relate to literacy outcomes.
research_interests: With deep expertise that connects research
